name: China Steel Structure Co., Ltd.
summary: China Steel Structure Co., Ltd., established in 1978 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, specializes in the design, fabrication, and distribution of steel structures across the island nation. The company's comprehensive services encompass the engineering, processing, manufacturing, assembly, and sales of diverse steel sections and frames. It provides expert technical consultation for steel structure projects, engages in the import, export, and trade of metal products, steel, and general construction materials, and offers construction and installation services for civil engineering works. Furthermore, the firm undertakes significant contracts for architectural developments, bridge construction, and steel structure erection. Its extensive range of steel products is utilized in various applications, from high-rise buildings, industrial facilities, and bridges to complex mechanical structures, petrochemical pipelines and storage tanks, and critical pipeline support systems. The company also exports its offerings to Mainland China and countries throughout Southeast Asia.
